note.en: Include a vertical pull, a row and controlled hip-hinge work across your training; choose manageable variations, progress gradually and allow recovery.
note.zh: 训练中安排垂直拉、划船和受控的髋折叠；选择能驾驭的版本，逐步进阶，并留出恢复时间。

title.en: A way to arrange a back session (an example, not a prescription)
title.zh: 一种背部训练课的安排（示例，不是处方）

note.en: Warm up with a high bar and an easy body angle; check the support and learn the shoulder-blade motion.
note.zh: 用较高横杆、较容易的身体倾角热身；检查支撑，熟悉肩胛骨运动。

note.en: Practise the main hip hinge while fresh, building from a light load; the spine holds steady as the hips and knees move.
note.zh: 精力充足时练主项髋折叠，从轻负重逐步准备；髋、膝移动，脊柱稳住。

note.en: Use a comfortable grip and keep the torso still; assistance and load should preserve a smooth return.
note.zh: 握法舒服，躯干稳住；辅助程度和重量要让回放仍然平稳。

note.en: Use the bench for support and give each side the same careful attention.
note.zh: 用凳子支撑，两边都认真控制动作。

note.en: Finish with an easy shoulder-control movement without added weight.
note.zh: 最后做容易的肩带控制动作，先不加重量。

note.en: Use very light loading for controlled rotation; stop before the torso or elbow compensates.
note.zh: 用很轻的负重控制外旋；躯干或手肘开始代偿前就停。

note.en: This order illustrates technique practice before fatigue and lighter shoulder work afterwards; not every exercise in the catalogue belongs in the same session. Rest enough to recover control, and adapt the selection with a qualified coach. First learn under supervision; minors practise with adult supervision. This is general information, not medical advice; seek a doctor or physiotherapist for pain or injury.
note.zh: 这个顺序示范了先在疲劳前练技术，再做较轻的肩部动作；动作目录中的所有动作不必塞进同一节课。休息到控制恢复，再由合格教练帮助调整选择。第一次学动作要有人指导；未成年人在成人监督下练习。本页是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；疼痛或受伤请咨询医生或物理治疗师。
